beats.say: Walter Koenig, the beloved Star Trek actor who played Pavel Chekov, has passed away aged 90.
Born in 1936, Koenig's acting career spanned over six decades, with his most iconic role being the navigator of the USS Enterprise.
Koenig was more than just Chekov, though. He was a writer, a teacher, and a loyal friend to his colleagues.
Both George Takei and William Shatner paid tribute to Koenig, describing him as a man who genuinely loved the Star Trek community.
Walter Koenig's impact on the Star Trek franchise and its fans will be felt for generations to come.
